# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_CONVERGENCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price pulling back to VWAP while the EMA ribbon is aligned and contracting offers dynamic support with rising momentum, creating a high-probability long entry. This targets mean-reversion pullbacks within an uptrend, distinct from pure continuation setups, by requiring both VWAP reclamation and ribbon contraction filters.

## Mechanism

Enter long when price closes above VWAP on a bar where: (1) 5-period EMA > 10-period EMA (bullish ribbon alignment), (2) ribbon width (max EMA - min EMA) < its 20-bar average (contraction), and (3) volume > 20-bar average volume. Exit: initial stop at recent swing low (chart-stop), TP1 at 1.5R, then runner trailed via chandelier exit (ATR-based) after TP1. Regime filters: VIX < 15 and time 10:00-12:00 ET; avoid VIX > 25 or first 15 minutes after open.
